assumptions.model: Production combat/automation, fixed level, starter weapon, supplied identical 2000 gold and materials. Not earned-farm progression.
assumptions.sustain: Changes to first unlocked healing skill, or Barbarian life-draining Bite when no pure heal is unlocked, prioritizes it and buys ranks; unavailable if none. Build and spending combined, not pure coefficient test.
assumptions.comparison: Group summaries combine two worlds above level 1; compare exact class/level/world/seed in raw runs. Paired combat RNG is reset before combat but diverges with actions. Default skill build for investments; all unlocked choices only in choices mode.

assumptions.model: Supplied starting levels 1/10/25/50 and worlds 1/1/2/3, normal starter equipment/resources, no purchases. Production XP, level-ups, stage progression and automatic portals remain enabled.
assumptions.limitations: Profiling snapshots, not proof of time required to earn starting levels/worlds. Rates average each evolving session, not a frozen level/world. Final levels and per-phase counters are included. No expansion/sales/recycling.

assumptions.equipmentScoring: Production auto-equip button; class-weighted, may sacrifice stats. Refine to +2 only.
assumptions.resources: Normal starter kit; all subsequent purchases use actual earned drops/gold. No grants, no offline claims, no sales, no expansion, no recycling.
assumptions.policies: none saves; skill buys slot 1 ranks; equipment equips weighted upgrades and refines weapon; fusion reserves for first compatible weapon fusion.
assumptions.limitations: Three seeds, solo default loadout, evolving levels/worlds. Not fixed-level farm at 10/25/50. Seeds match at start but subsequent actions change RNG use. Currency affordability is not necessarily an optimal purchase.
